thematic_fit_momentum.environment_layer: tilt scores A 100, B 75, C 50, D 25, F 0 on the stock's industry, sector and geography; mean of those present; fixed bands A 87.5+, B 62.5+, C 37.5+, D 12.5+, F below
thematic_fit_momentum.stock_layer: thematic-tailwind exposure weight 1.0 at A or B, 0.5 at C, 0 at D or F; external-force exposure weight 1.0 at A, B, D or F, 0 at C, direction by grade; only thematic, industry and sector tags move the grade (version one), and never a tag naming the stock's own sector or own industry, which the environment layer already scores (D-EMR-26)
thematic_fit_momentum.combination: sum rounded half away from zero, capped at 2 grade steps either way; never above B unless the environment base is B or better

how_these_readings_are_set.tsr_valuation: the Investment Analyst's Modal return (the plausible total shareholder return a year, over eighteen months and three years, at the fair multiple the analyst chose), re-based every night to that night's price; graded on the average of the two re-based returns (one where only one is stated), rounded to one decimal: A 25.0+, B 18.0 to 24.99, C 13.0 to 17.99, D 10.0 to 12.99, F below 10.0 (Richard's anchors: 20 percent is a B). Where there is no Modal return (no conveyor memo yet), the valuation reading (the P/E against the stock's own ten-year history, ranked across the universe) stands in, labelled 'valuation reading only'. It ranks, it never gates; a two-grade disagreement between the two goes to the override list
how_these_readings_are_set.fragility_modifier: (fragility fit - 62) x 0.2, clipped to plus or minus 10 points
how_these_readings_are_set.memo_worthy: in the Pool of Stocks Eligible for Portfolio Consideration at the latest month-end reading, and no conveyor memo yet (no memo, an old-scheme memo, or a memo older than 365 days); which of them get memos, and in what order, is the commissioner's, by position on the Ideas Lists
how_these_readings_are_set.entry_merit: bottom-up composite B or better and a recommendation direction of progress or other

entry_timing.text: in the Pool at the latest month-end reading, and Sell-side Momentum, Thematic Fit/Momentum and Technical Momentum C or better; TSR/Valuation ranks but never gates

how_these_readings_are_set.pool_flag: the Pool of Stocks Eligible for Portfolio Consideration (APM - Stage 2 Gate-4 Backtest, signed off 28-Sep-26 and 29-Sep-26), read at the latest month-end, in an Uptrend month-end only: market value EUR 500m or more; the stock's relative strength over the last twelve months (Stock RS L12M Composite) 80 or more; its sector's (Sector RS L12M) 50 or more; the sell-side's net upgrades of next year's sales estimates (SS Sales Net Upgrade Breadth) 0 or more. Month-end readings decide the following month; the daily reading is information
how_these_readings_are_set.alert: a fall of 1 grade or more week on week in any top-down rating of a live holding or Ideas Bench name (information only)
how_these_readings_are_set.rare_one: 5 or more of the eight at A or B, with 6 or more present
how_these_readings_are_set.staleness: bottom-up rating older than 365 days: stale, memo due; weekly reading older than 14 days: weekly run missed; three-year horizon under twelve months: memo due
how_these_readings_are_set.override_life: until the next weekly run's first writer call, or 14 days
